steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with its draft award proposal.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Require the Note to Director configuration specified for the proposal flow.
Record that the original two real vendor columns are present before opening the proposal.
Verify the original bid amounts and totals before the cancellation attempt.
Verify the original ranking before the cancellation attempt.
Open the existing draft award proposal from Master QCS.
Confirm navigation to the award proposal page.
Confirm that the Submit Proposal window opened.
Cancel the submission without submitting or changing the proposal.
Confirm the Submit Proposal window closed while remaining on the proposal page.
Confirm the proposal remains available for submission and was not submitted.
Return to Master QCS to recheck the event's vendors and bids.
Verify the vendor columns are unchanged after cancellation.
Verify bid amounts and totals are unchanged after cancellation.
Verify bid rankings are unchanged after cancellation.
